\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch11:11-2↗ prop:jacobi-field-hessian-equation ↗ prop:fermi-coordinates-radial-function ↗ prob:transverse-jacobi-field

Prove the following extension to Proposition 11.2: Suppose $P$ is an embedded submanifold of a Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$, $U$ is a normal neighborhood of $P$ in $M$, and $r$ is the radial distance function for $P$ in $U$ (see Prop. 6.37). If $\gamma : [0,b] \to U$ is a geodesic segment with $\gamma (0) \in P$ and $\gamma '(0)$ normal to $P$, and $J$ is a Jacobi field along $\gamma $ that is transverse to $P$ in the sense of Problem 10-14, then $D_t J(t) = \mathcal{H}_r(J(t))$ for all $t \in [0,b]$. \end{exercise}
